candidates.name: Internal Herniation
support_spans: a cluster of small-bowel loops in the left upper quadrant, positioned anterior to the splenic flexure
The central mesenteric vessels exhibited a spiral (whirl) pattern, with congestion of mesenteric fat and stretching and convergence of vessels
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with internal herniation, which is a known complication of Roux-en-Y gastric bypass surgery.

candidates.name: Adhesive Bowel Obstruction
